method: T3 html_preview; real components; local seeded fixtures; no Convex writes. CSS viewport units resolved to iframe pixels. Wicket retakes have animations disabled for settled modal captures. round3.method: T3 html_preview only. Retained inlined Vite IIFE harness; real components, local storage and seeded fixtures; auth/Convex/broadcast mocked. A 360x640 or 390x844 iframe fixes the viewport. Script clicks dispatch through actual React handlers; initial hydration and remount effects settle before probes. Console messages are forwarded from the iframe. Measurements are returned by html_preview; captures are dimension checked. No full browser-process restart or live-system write.
